blocks.heading: Inactivity, Complaints and Rule Changes
blocks.summary: Three rules of the terms that touch an account: inactivity, complaints about account decisions and changes of the terms.
connections: customer support to request a review of a dispute or an account decision
blocks.notes: Three facts, exactly as in the Brand Information: prolonged inactivity may trigger an account review or closure under the applicable terms; a dispute or an account decision is reviewed when the player contacts customer support; the operator may modify promotional and contractual terms and publishes updates on the site. No time limits, no named regulator or ombudsman, no dispute deadlines and no promise of an outcome. Calm and factual.

blocks.heading: Common Login Questions
blocks.summary: 7 short questions and answers on the login and the account.
blocks.notes: A bulleted list of 7 items in the form "- **Question?** Answer." (bold question, then a one-sentence answer); bold is required here for the question text only. Questions, in this order: (1) how to log in (with the registered e-mail and password, as the page explains); (2) what to do after a forgotten password (request a reset link with the registered e-mail); (3) which identity document is accepted (passport, national identity card or driving licence); (4) how long verification takes (a complete document set is normally reviewed within up to 10 days); (5) what the minimum age is (18, and the player must be legally permitted to gamble where they live); (6) where to turn when the login still fails (customer support: live chat 24/7 or e-mail; do not print the e-mail address); (7) what prolonged inactivity can lead to (an account review or closure under the terms). Answers repeat the facts of the sections of the page in other words and add nothing new. Do not answer questions about multiple devices, lockouts or login limits: no data.
